name: Summit Pizza Co. Warm "Cinnadoodles" (Cinnamon Cream Cheese Swirled Dough)
brandOrRestaurant: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City / Bear Lake & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Unlike the Raspberry Doodles (which contain raspberry seeds), Cinnadoodles are 100% seedless soft-baked dough swirled with cinnamon sugar and cream cheese.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose Cinnadoodles over Raspberry Doodles for a seed-free dessert at Summit Pizza, and take a Lactaid for the cream cheese frosting.
watchOuts: Lactose in cream cheese filling and frosting side cup
